# PAGE 2019-07-15 schema

`pagecontent-2019-07-15.xsd` is the unchanged PAGE XML schema from <https://www.primaresearch.org/schema/PAGE/gts/pagecontent/2019-07-15/pagecontent.xsd> (SHA-256 `5d7da5af5f5e06d3b9cd1e78b407ffca1862f78ad9823ed89c302fb6409932d5`), published by PRImA Research Lab under the Apache License 2.0 ([`LICENSE`](LICENSE), from <https://github.com/PRImA-Research-Lab/PAGE-XML>). `tests/test_archer.py` validates the importer's generated PAGE XML against it offline.
